source_pr_title: Fix SSH host keys for OpenShift restricted SCC
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Security Vulnerability**: StrictModes=no disables SSH's critical permission checks. This allows SSH to accept host keys and configuration files with insecure permissions, creating potential attack vectors. Since the PR uses a dedicated directory under HOME with controlled permissions, StrictModes should remain enabled. Remove this option to maintain SSH security hardening.[^1]
```suggestion
        -o "PidFile=$SSH_KEY_DIR/sshd.pid"
```

[^1]: CWE-732: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/732.html

source_pr_title: Fix SSH host keys for OpenShift restricted SCC
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Security Vulnerability**: Fallback to /tmp creates race condition and defeats persistent storage. If HOME is unset, SSH keys will be generated in world-writable /tmp, exposing them to potential tampering or theft by other users. This also defeats the PR's stated goal of persisting keys across pod restarts. Remove the /tmp fallback and fail explicitly if HOME is not set.[^1]
```suggestion
      SSH_KEY_DIR="''${HOME}/.ssh-host-keys"
```

[^1]: CWE-377: Insecure Temporary File - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/377.html
